articles.title: "Power of Unity - 2026" Joint Military Exercise commences
articles.description: The opening ceremony of the "Power of Unity - 2026" joint military exercise, involving military personnel from Azerbaijan, Türkiye, and Uzbekistan, was held, the Ministry of Defense told AZERTAC.
